journalRule: Two doors: created inside the last 24 hours and up at least 30%, or any age doing a 5x or better. Both require $150,000 market cap and $50,000 of 24-hour volume. Safety problems are labelled on the row; only a live mint or freeze authority, unlocked liquidity, bundled supply or a manufactured tape removes a coin from the record.
selectionRule: Every track requires market cap at least $150,000, liquidity at least $20,000, a passed safety gate, and an unreused ticker. NEW: created inside 24h with at least 3 strength and 2 interest signals, maximum 5 names. MOVER: any age up to 2d, at least 25% in 24h on $100,000 volume and 0.50x turnover, maximum 5 names. CTO: takeover claimed within 7d with measurable post-claim activity, maximum 3 names.
